description: Test suite for RedisCache class in the litellm project, specifically testing Redis caching functionalities including async cache increment, batch get, Redis version handling, and compatibility with various Redis versions and configurations.

methods.name: redis_no_ping()
methods.description: Fixture that patches RedisCache initialization to prevent async ping tasks from being created.

methods.name: test_redis_cache_async_increment(namespace, monkeypatch, redis_no_ping)
methods.description: Tests the asynchronous increment cache method of RedisCache, verifying that it correctly calls the Redis 'incrbyfloat' method.

methods.name: test_redis_client_init_with_socket_timeout(monkeypatch, redis_no_ping)
methods.description: Verifies that the RedisCache initializes a client with specified socket timeout configuration.

methods.name: test_redis_cache_async_batch_get_cache(monkeypatch, redis_no_ping)
methods.description: Tests the batch retrieval from cache, ensuring proper decoding and handling of missing keys.

methods.name: test_handle_lpop_count_for_older_redis_versions(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Ensures the helper method for handling LPOP with count behaves correctly with pipelined Redis commands.

methods.name: test_async_lpop_with_float_redis_version( monkeypatch, redis_no_ping, redis_version )
methods.description: Tests compatibility of async_lpop with various Redis version formats, including float, string, malformed, and edge cases, addressing issues with AWS ElastiCache returns.
